tasks.title: Create PolicyService, ClaimService, HailEventService with domain logic
tasks.acceptance_prose: Three service classes compile. PolicyService creates policies with premium validation. ClaimService implements submit→assess workflow with status machine. HailEventService registers events and links claims.

tasks.title: Create ClaimController and HailEventController with REST endpoints and @PreAuthorize
tasks.acceptance_prove: Two controllers compile. ClaimController: POST/GET/PUT endpoints, @PreAuthorize on assess. HailEventController: POST/GET endpoints.

tasks.title: Create JWT security: JwtService, JwtAuthFilter, SecurityConfig, AppProperties
tasks.acceptance_prose: JWT auth compiles. SecurityConfig is stateless with BCrypt, method security. JwtAuthFilter extracts Bearer token. AppProperties is a record with @ConfigurationProperties.

tasks.acceptance_prose: Health indicator, data initializer, and YAML configs compile. DataInitializer seeds 1 farmer, 1 assessor, 1 plot, 1 policy, 1 claim, 1 hail event.

tasks.title: Create test suite: unit, slice, integration tests
tasks.acceptance_prose: All tests pass: @SpringBootTest contextLoads, PolicyServiceTest (create, premium validation), ClaimServiceTest (submit, assess), ClaimControllerTest (create, 400, 403), PolicyControllerTest (create, 400), PolicyRepositoryTest (save, findByStatus).
